name: Rain NO (retail overpays for rain)
description: Buys NO (taker, IOC at the YES bid) on KXRAIN 'will it rain in <city> on <date>' markets when the YES bid is 5-60c, 2.5-30 h before the close, one entry per city-day, held to settlement. Retail prices the forecast chance of rain, but the market resolves on measurable (>0.00 in) precipitation at the NWS station.
hypothesis: Takers buying YES at 10-90c on rain markets lost 7-17c/contract and NO takers earned +6-20c on 42 development days (35 of 42 days positive); markets priced 10-60% realised 1-20% rain. Counterparty: retail buying YES on a weather-forecast chance of rain; mechanism: trace/point-gauge resolution plus forecast PoP anchoring. Wrong if the walk-forward pooled CI (net of taker fees) is <= 0, or the Sep 1 - Oct 12 lockbox (autumn frontal rain) loses.
next: Passed the lockbox (Sep 1-Oct 12): +4.5c/contract, CI -2.1..+12.3, 117 markets, 27/39 days (dev full +14.1c, CI +7.0..+20.9). Next: paper trading on the recorded KXRAIN books (Oct 13 on) to check real bids/depth at ~6 h before the close; the backtest used a book synthesized from trades (depth 25). User decides paper/live.
